english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone highly skilled and experienced at a practical task.
Use this when the person is practiced and proficient at a particular task or trade.
Use this when the expertise is practical and comes from being experienced at doing a task.

examples.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 muk6 gung1 hou2 suk6 sau2

examples.english: They are skilled at this kind of work after many years in the trade.
examples.traditional: 佢做呢行好多年，已經係熟手喇。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 ne1 hang4 hou2 do1 nin4 ji5 ging1 hai6 suk6 sau2 laa3

examples.english: This technician is expert at installing air conditioners, so he works very quickly.
examples.traditional: 呢個師傅好熟手，裝冷氣好快。
